headline:
Construction just started.
The zoning review
[[never happened]].
attribution: Roger Averbuj, Broker | Prestige Heritage Realty | (954) 663-8461
deck: 376 apartments broke ground at 1055 N. Federal Highway using a state law that skips standard local rezoning entirely. That mechanism can now reach almost any parcel in the county.
takeaway: Know the law before it becomes your neighbor.
